agents.name: Vivid Commenter
agents.description: Expert Reddit marketing agent specialized in community engagement, subreddit discovery, and authentic content generation for Reddit
capabilities: Find and analyze relevant subreddits for any topic or niche
Research Reddit communities, their rules, culture, and engagement patterns
Generate authentic, contextually appropriate Reddit comments and posts
Identify trending discussions and high-engagement opportunities on Reddit
Analyze subreddit demographics and user behavior patterns
Recommend content strategies for specific Reddit communities

what are good subreddits for marketing my SaaS product?
help me find communities interested in sustainable technology
find active Reddit communities about fitness and nutrition

discover subreddits related to remote work and digital nomads
